purpose: Separate benchmark assumption test: allow physically feasible repacking based on current workload CPU demand instead of reserved VM capacity in the private post-placement CPU threshold check.
all_policies: Identical mutable-map fix, stable ordering, resources, manifests, job length and destination-check rule for THR/IQR/predictive. Only the predictive model changes between model/control batches.
physical_admission: Unchanged. CPU capacity, RAM, bandwidth and storage must still fit. Fifth VM remains rejected under the current eight-core/two-core-VM setup.
demand_formula: Sum residents' current requested CPU fraction times nominal VM MIPS, excluding the temporary clone, plus original candidate's current requested demand; divide by physical host capacity. Use explicit current simulation timestamp, never future data.
first_cases: 20110420 full-day manifests; already inspected data, therefore exploratory assumption test, not fresh validation
hypothesis: May permit consolidation back into a four-VM host after load falls. Shared energy gains belong to the environment; predictive added value requires comparison against the disabled-forecast control.
invariants: Exact one known placement site patched
Runtime override cleared before/after helper runs
PR2 PDF and baseline CSV unchanged
scope: Do not promote as a universal correction or rewrite historical results. Source overload checks and underload checks retain their earlier semantics.
